etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: mountain (山) + up (上) + down (下) — where the climb turns to descent: the pass; the crisis point (峠を越す).
mnemonic: Up, then the ridge, then down — とうげ. 峠: illness and hikes both have one.

etymology: Phono-semantic: box (匚) + 若 (phonetic トク) — tucked out of sight: to conceal.
mnemonic: Folded into the cupboard — トク. 匿名: the nameless comment's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 叔 (phonetic トク) + eye (目) — the watching eye over the work: to superintend.
mnemonic: The uncle-eye on your form — トク. 監督: coach and film director.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 馬 (phonetic トク) — solid as a steady horse: earnest; grave (危篤).
mnemonic: Devotion at draft-horse strength — トク. 危篤: gravely — the hospital call.

etymology: Pictograph: a shape with a boss protruding — convex. Partner of 凹.
mnemonic: The bump drawn as itself — トツ. 凸凹: the road report in two glyphs.

etymology: Pictograph: the sprout gathering force underground — massed troops waiting: garrison.
mnemonic: Force coiled below the surface — トン. 駐屯地: the garrison base.

etymology: Compound ideograph: flesh (月) + pig (豕) — the pig as food: pork.
mnemonic: The pig with a menu destiny — ぶた. 豚カツ: the kanji, breaded.

etymology: Old phonetic character for transcription — 'which/that'; survives in names (那覇) and 旦那.
mnemonic: The syllable that settled in Okinawa — ナ. 那覇: Naha; 旦那: the husband, borrowed from Sanskrit.

etymology: From Sanskrit bhikṣuṇī via 比丘尼 — the Buddhist nun.
mnemonic: The robe and the shaved head — あま. 尼寺: the convent temple.

etymology: The forgery-proof legal 'two' — 二 armored with extra strokes for documents.
mnemonic: 二 in a bank vault — ニ. 金弐万円: two, notarized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 虫 (the old dragon-serpent) + 工 (phonetic コウ) — the sky-serpent arching to drink: rainbow.
mnemonic: The dragon bending between two clouds — にじ. 虹: the sky's bridge kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 口 (phonetic ジョ) — following as told: like, as; suchness (如来).
mnemonic: 'Just as said' — ごとく. 突如: as if from nowhere; 如来: the Thus-Come Buddha.

etymology: Compound ideograph: water (水) from the body (尸) — urine. Clinical and unblushing.
mnemonic: The diagram explains itself — ニョウ. 尿検査: the little cup at the clinic.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 壬 'carrying' (phonetic ニン) — carrying life: pregnant.
mnemonic: The carried weight that kicks — ニン. 妊娠: with 娠, the full announcement.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 刃 (phonetic ニン) + heart (心) — the heart under the blade, unmoving: to endure; unseen endurance: stealth.
mnemonic: A blade on the heart and not a sound — しのぶ. 忍者: endurance, weaponized.

etymology: Compound: the heart fed and housed — at peace: tranquil; 'rather' (むしろ) by extension.
mnemonic: Everything in its place under the roof — ネイ. 丁寧: care, roofed and fed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 占 (phonetic ネン) — the grain's cling: sticky, tenacious.
mnemonic: Rice that won't let go of the bowl — ねばる. 粘り: the virtue of natto and negotiators.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 巴 (phonetic ハ) — the closed grip: to grasp; a handle on a situation (把握).
mnemonic: Fingers around the whole of it — ハ. 把握: getting the grip, mentally.

etymology: Originally the moon's first light reclaiming the sky — the overlord who claims all: hegemony.
mnemonic: The new moon annexing the night — ハ. 制覇: total conquest — tournaments included.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 波 (phonetic バ) + woman (女) — the grandmother: old woman.
mnemonic: The woman with wave-lines of years — ばあ. お婆さん: the folktale's second resident.

etymology: Phono-semantic: building (广) + 発 (phonetic ハイ) — the hall let go to ruin: to abolish, fall into disuse.
mnemonic: The institution with its lights off — すたれる. 廃墟: the explorer's ruin.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 非 (phonetic ハイ) — pushed out and away: to expel, exclude.
mnemonic: Both hands showing it the door — ハイ. 排気: the exhaust pipe's verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 非 (phonetic ハイ) + 車 — carts in rank: one's cohort: fellows.
mnemonic: The convoy you entered service with — ハイ. 先輩・後輩: the whole social ladder.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 咅 (phonetic バイ) — earth banked at the roots: to cultivate.
mnemonic: Soil heaped with intention — つちかう. 栽培 and 培う: crops and character.

etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 某 (phonetic バイ) — the matchmaker: go-between; the carrying medium.
mnemonic: The one who carries messages between — バイ. 媒体: the media — professional go-betweens.

etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 咅 (phonetic バイ) — payment for damage: indemnity.
mnemonic: The check that says sorry — バイ. 賠償: reparations, itemized.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 咅 (phonetic バイ) — seated alongside in attendance: auxiliary.
mnemonic: The extra chairs beside the bench — バイ. 陪審: the jury's kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — the elder of the line: chief, count; uncle (伯父).
mnemonic: The white-haired senior brother — ハク. 伯爵: the count of novels.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — palm on palm: to clap; the beat it keeps.
mnemonic: Hands keeping the count — ハク. 拍手: applause; 拍子: the rhythm it makes.

etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — the ocean-going vessel: liner.
mnemonic: The big white hull from abroad — ハク. 舶来品: goods off the liner — imports.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — closing in: to press, approach menacingly.
mnemonic: The deadline's headlights in the mirror — せまる. 迫力: pressure you can feel from a screen.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 莫 'none' (phonetic バク) — waterless expanse: desert; featureless: vague.
mnemonic: Water written where none exists — バク. 漠然: fog-shaped thinking; 砂漠: the desert itself.

etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 尃 (phonetic バク) — roped fast: to bind.
mnemonic: Wound until movement is theory — しばる. 束縛: the relationship red flag.

etymology: From Sanskrit pātra via 鉢多羅 — the monk's alms bowl: bowl, flowerpot.
mnemonic: The begging bowl that took up gardening — はち. 植木鉢: the balcony's pot.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the weapon (戈) at the person (亻) — to strike down: to fell (trees, enemies).
mnemonic: The axe swing, forestry or war — バツ. 伐採: logging's verb.

etymology: Compound: caught (罒), sentenced (言), enforced (刂) — punishment.
mnemonic: Net, verdict, blade: the full pipeline — バツ. 罰金: the fine; バチが当たる: cosmic 罰.

etymology: Phono-semantic: gate (門) + 伐 (phonetic バツ) — the gate only insiders pass: faction, clique.
mnemonic: The door with an unwritten guest list — バツ. 財閥: the zaibatsu conglomerates.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 半 (phonetic ハン) — one's other half on the road: to accompany.
mnemonic: The half that walks beside — ともなう. 伴奏: the accompaniment, musical or marital.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 凡 (phonetic ハン) — the wind-cloth: sail.
mnemonic: Cloth doing the engine's job — ほ. 出帆: setting sail.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 般 (phonetic ハン) — moved by hand and boat: to transport.
mnemonic: The moving crew's kanji — ハン. 運搬: haulage, invoiced.

etymology: Phono-semantic: field (田) + 半 (phonetic ハン) — the dividing ridge: levee; the water's edge (湖畔).
mnemonic: The walkable line between paddies — ハン. 湖畔: the lakeside hotel's word.

etymology: Compound: threads multiplying every (毎) which way — thriving thick: flourishing, busy.
mnemonic: Growth outpacing the pruning — ハン. 繁華街: downtown at full leaf.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hedge (艹) + a phonetic (ハン) — the fenced fief: the Edo domain: han.
mnemonic: The hedge around a daimyo's map square — ハン. 藩: every samurai drama's political unit.

etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + a phonetic (ハン) — the bamboo mold: model, scope (範囲).
mnemonic: The template everyone traces — ハン. 模範 and 師範: the model, and your gym leaders 師範.

etymology: Compound ideograph: fire (火) at the head (頁) — the burning head: vexation.
mnemonic: A head on low boil — わずらう. 煩悩: the 108 desires the New Year bell strikes away.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 分 (phonetic ハン) + 頁 — dealt out per head: to distribute.
mnemonic: One share per head, official — ハン. 頒布: the handout word.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 般 (phonetic バン) + dish (皿) — the broad flat base: tray, board, disc.
mnemonic: The surface games are played on — バン. 基盤: the foundation board; 円盤: the disc.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 蠻): a phonetic + 虫 — the old slur for southern peoples: barbarian.
mnemonic: History's rude label, kanji form — バン. 南蛮: the 'southern barbarian' trade era — and the chicken dish.
